verdicts.reason: A stacks every text element in one cramped right column in a jumbled order (Best Offers, then the URL, then Black Friday, then the date). The URL is as prominent as the offer, the pink panel has shrunk to a thin strip with its underline running past the edge, and the colourful brand graphics are reduced to tiny scraps in the bottom-left corner. B keeps a clearer hierarchy (large TV DEALS headline on the left, then the pink date box, Best Offers and the URL), but 'Black Friday' is tiny, low-contrast and stranded at the far right away from the headline, Best Offers has lost its pink panel, and the graphics are jammed into the middle beside the date box.
